# GROWSPEC Bio

GROWSPEC Bio publishes technical product dossiers, application planning guides and ROI tools for vertical farming systems, aeroponic container farms, modular controlled environment agriculture rooms, compact grow cabinets, propagation racks and specialty crop systems.

## Primary capabilities
- Controlled environment agriculture (CEA) system design
- Aeroponic vertical farming hardware
- Turnkey container farm systems
- Modular indoor farm rooms
- LED grow lighting, fertigation, climate control and SaaS/IoT monitoring
- ROI planning for commercial indoor farming projects
- Application planning for restaurant, hotel and premium retail growing systems

## Technical product pages
- BioCube Container: https://www.growspecbio.com/products/biocube-container/ — technical specifications, crop systems, power, cooling, lighting, fertigation and 40ft CEA planning data.
- BioCube Modular: https://www.growspecbio.com/products/biocube-modular/ — scalable modular indoor farm architecture and commercial crop-room technical data.
- FarmCube Nano: https://www.growspecbio.com/products/farmcube-nano/ — four-tier aeroponic grow cabinet specifications and application data for microgreens, herbs and leafy greens.
- FarmCube Ultra: https://www.growspecbio.com/products/farmcube-ultra/ — aeroponic research chamber for crop trials, education and biotech research.
- FarmCube Neo: https://www.growspecbio.com/products/farmcube-neo/ — Neo-2T and Neo-5T technical specifications, crop output, aeroponic irrigation, power, airflow and operating data.
- Pegma Germin: https://www.growspecbio.com/products/pegma-germin/ — aeroponic propagation rack for seedling, germination and early-stage crop production.
- Pegma Omni-4: https://www.growspecbio.com/products/pegma-omni/ — professional aeroponic grow kit for tall plants, specialty crop trials and controlled cultivation.
- ROI Calculator: https://www.growspecbio.com/roi-calculator/ — indoor farming ROI calculator for CAPEX, OPEX, revenue, payback and profit planning.

## Application planning guides
- Restaurant Microgreens Growing System: https://www.growspecbio.com/applications/restaurant-microgreens-growing-system/ — demand planning, FarmCube Neo capacity, workflow and installation guidance for restaurants.
- Hotel Indoor Herb Garden: https://www.growspecbio.com/applications/hotel-indoor-herb-garden/ — outlet demand, placement, crop planning and operating guidance for hotels.
- Microgreens Cabinet for Premium Retail: https://www.growspecbio.com/applications/premium-retail-microgreens-cabinet/ — visible growing, crop rotation, placement and retail operating guidance.
